input.name: x
input.meaning: the page in grey, ink high (1 - grey/255), scaled to height 640 with the resize of pipeline.json, padded with 0 to a width that is a multiple of 16

output.name: y
output.meaning: channel 0: baseline logit; 1 and 2: distance up and down from the baseline, divided by 64.0

input.name: x
input.meaning: letter ids: symbol i of the alphabet in spacer.json is i + 2, 1 unknown; L from 1 to 256, no padding needed (a batch of windows of different lengths is padded with 0 to the longest: padding is masked)

output.name: y
output.meaning: logit of a word space after each letter; those of any padding are ignored
